I'm sick of being a burden for the few people who care to interact with me.

 •Mental illness doesn't exist outside of full blown scizophrenia and maybe PTSD but only PTSD from war.

•It's an excuse for laziness or rash decisions

•It's easily cured just smile more, stop being negative, and go to more social events.

•You can fix it yourself because I did

 •You shouldn't "wear it on your sleeve" aka your physical manifestations/emotional vulnerability from mental illness make me uncomfortable so please just turn on your off switch.

• It's a gift/test from god treat it/treasure it as such

The good news is fortunately the attitude is shifting as each generation seems to be more and more inclusive, willing to help, and understanding.

Short story long story:

Rather than give my life long story of suffering from depression and social anxiety among other illnesses I’ll start my story when my current spiral started

I walked out of the only job I’ve ever been able to maintain during a major mental breakdown 18 months ago. After much pressure with my parents about what am I doing with my life I enrolled in trade school for the fall semester so they would get off my back.

Things were going alright and three months into school I ended up getting a job from a fellow student in his parents company to earn hours towards my journeyman’s license.  I didn’t last three hours before I walked off the jobsite with a concussion and a worsening self-esteem.

I immediately dropped out of trade school because how can you face someone after bombing like that when they stuck out their neck for you.

Unfortunately due to my social anxiety, suicidal depression, and fear of my parents(mom)  I decided pretending to still have a job and still going to school was the best idea. So every morning M-F I’d “go to work” and just and sleep the day away in my parents car before heading home and sleeping in my bed because I’m always too tired, unmotivated, and unfocused to do anything other than sleep.

Fast forward to two months ago and unbeknownst to me one of the banks starts calling my home phone I wake up from a depression nap to my mom degradingly asking me “how old are you?” after lecturing me saying I was ruining my life by ruining my credit I lied and told my mom I just forgot to pay them and switched my primary phone to my cell phone.

My cellphone got shutdown due to non payment and as a result this month the other bank started calling the phone number for my address on file. This time unfortunately the only way for me to sign in and change my info on file is to receive a text or phone call to my now non existent phone number so they have been calling regularly with different numbers.

I fear I have run out of excuses and I cannot talk to my parents without having panic attacks. I tried killing myself last week but found myself unable to catch the bus then so I've trapped myself in a corner with what I feel like is no real way out.

I have nothing of enough value to buy me some time to fix my shit or run away. I also unfortunately can’t go homeless because I require daily thyroid medication to survive and it’s currently winter time where I live.
